summary: The POS Minimum Quantity module for Odoo allows you to set minimum order quantities directly in the Point of Sale. Once enabled, it ensures that a predefined minimum quantity of a product is automatically added to the order line when selected. You can also configure a default minimum quantity for all products, helping standardize sales and improve efficiency at checkout. The POS Minimum Quantity module for Odoo allows you to define and enforce minimum product quantities directly in your Point of Sale system. Instead of adding a single unit by default, the POS automatically applies the predefined minimum quantity whenever a product is added to the order line. This feature ensures consistent sales practices, improves stock control, and simplifies bulk sales by reducing manual input for cashiers. Businesses can configure either a global minimum quantity that applies to all products or define individual minimum quantities per product for more flexibility. Perfect for retailers, wholesale outlets, grocery stores, restaurants, and businesses selling in bulk, this module standardizes transactions and prevents under-selling.
